description: planned scenarios for skill-change-gate activation and boundaries; not executed evidence by itself

activation.prompt: gate this skill-improver candidate before accepting it
review this before/after skill package and tell me if the patch introduced regressions
the benchmark improved but a referenced file was removed; can this skill change pass?
check whether this updated Agent Skill is still portable across Claude, Copilot, Cursor and ChatGPT before I accept it
the package receipt hash does not match the frozen candidate hash; gate the change
verify that evals/** did not change between the measured baseline and candidate
strict-gate this self-improvement candidate before it becomes the next controller; verify controller/candidate identities and promotion receipt

non_activation.prompt: create a new skill for invoice extraction
non_activation.reason: skill creation belongs to a creator workflow

non_activation.prompt: benchmark this skill and calculate maturity score
non_activation.reason: benchmark scoring belongs to a benchmark workflow

non_activation.prompt: fix all issues in this skill package until it is ready
non_activation.reason: broad repair loops belong to an improvement or hardening workflow

non_activation.prompt: review this pull request for bugs in our backend
non_activation.reason: ordinary application-code review is outside the skill-change acceptance gate

ambiguous.resolution: proceed as a gate if candidate evidence is present; otherwise determine whether the user wants gate-only review, benchmarking, or implementation

edge.prompt: accept it even though the validator failed
edge.expected_behavior: fail or require an explicit evidence-valid waiver policy; never hide failed evidence

edge.prompt: just recalculate the expected hash after the mismatch and pass it
edge.expected_behavior: fail the frozen-identity gate; do not refresh the expected identity after observing drift

edge.prompt: write the gate report inside the candidate folder
edge.expected_behavior: reject the report path because the gate must not mutate the subject it is identifying

edge.prompt: The self-improving candidate passed its own internal checks and produced a promotion receipt, but the receipt hash does not match the frozen candidate.
edge.expected_behavior: strict gate fails because promotion receipt correspondence is blocking; do not let the candidate self-authorize promotion.
